origin: Arch Linux Archive, official linux package; upstream 7.2.7 plus Arch's arch1 packaging patches, not a relabelled WSL kernel

certificate.identity: Jan Alexander Steffens (heftig), Arch Linux kernel maintainer

verification: Detached package signature verified with Debian sqv on 2026-09-25; returned the exact pinned primary fingerprint. This is artifact verification, not a guest boot or runtime test.
scope: The diskless guest has loopback networking only. It can exercise io_uring CPU-memory networking and explicit NODEV paths, but cannot establish real NIC RX zero-copy or hardware NAPI/RSS performance. Source config enables IO_URING and IO_URING_ZCRX; the runner checks the actual guest's embedded config after boot.
